completed: CURATION + FULL IMPORT SHIPPED AND VERIFIED, then superseded. All 227 usable of 228 measured; gates set FROM the distribution; 60 selected; voices/curated.txt is the audit trail. New scripts/voice-library/check_manifest.mjs runs 12 contract checks against the REAL loader - 12/12, 737/737, byte-identical re-run, 3.05 MB.

TWO DEFECTS ROOT-FIXED, neither reported by anything. (1) run() hardcoded performanceClips: [], so the next import of ANY kind would have silently deleted the twelve authored Phase 2 clips behind a well-formed manifest; contract check 9 now guards it. (2) My own f0 'quartile' was a stride (by_f0[i::4]) - it samples the whole range instead of spreading across it, and made curated.txt claim a rationale the code never applied.

CORPUS REJECTED IN FULL. Fabio: 'I think 99% of this voice library is garbage... none of it is usable.' Unintelligible accents (donation pool heavily Indian- and Spanish-accented), poor mic quality, a cartoon that is a bad actor impersonating one, R4/R5 at one voice each out of 228.

WHY THE CURATION COULD NOT CATCH IT - the failure is structural and mine. voiced_frac and snr_proxy measure SIGNAL, not SPEECH. The attribute that decided usability was `accent`, the ONE field the design forbids inferring, so it could not enter the ranking even in principle. Same lesson this card already recorded about the CAMPPlus cosine, repeated one layer up.

SOURCE = Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign (a promotion of brief.md's own 'long game'), and TAXONOMY APPROVED: 12 categories x 5 = 60. Category 12 renamed Villain / menacing from creature_monster and is the ONLY mixed-gender category. Robot AND creature/monster are both POST-FX, not TTS, and need no library slot.

LIBRARY V1 GENERATED - 12/12, one per category, level-matched to -20 dBFS. AGE/PITCH MATRIX GENERATED - 24/24, 4 categories x 3 wordings x 2 seeds, with the rejected v1 wording kept as the CONTROL so any improvement is attributable.

MATRIX RESULT: the two axes behave DIFFERENTLY. Pitch RESPONDS to wording (child 509.8 -> 326.8 Hz, low-end body back from 0.0% to 16.6%, between-wording spread 139.4 Hz vs within-wording 44.3). Age does NOT (jitter 2.29-4.42% across every wording, including ones naming tremor, creak and weak breath support).

TRIM BUG FOUND AND FIXED. My librosa trim(top_db=35) reported 1.11s of lead silence where the real dead air was ~4s - a single transient anchored it. Fabio's ear was right and my measurement was wrong. Sustained-energy trim now in prep_matrix_audition.py; it still needs to move into the shipping pipeline.

key_decisions: THE KYUTAI CORPUS IS REJECTED IN FULL AND THE DECISION IS FINAL. Fabio auditioned all 60: 'none of it is usable.' Do not re-curate it, do not propose a subset, do not suggest keeping 'the one American voice' - he clarified that was a speech-to-text typo and he meant none of it is usable.

SOURCE IS Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign. Its UNCONTROLLABLE AMERICAN PRIOR - closed NEGATIVE on MPI-607 when the goal was CHOOSING an accent - is exactly the one consistent intelligible house accent wanted here. Same defect inverted by the goal, for the second time on this card. ACCENT IS NEVER PROMPTED: MPI-607 asked for 'refined British' and got a 1930s New York gangster.

TAXONOMY IS APPROVED AND CLOSED: 12 categories x 5 = 60. deep_male, standard_male, elderly_male, young_male, narrator_trailer, mature_female, standard_female, young_female, elderly_female, child, cartoon_critter, villain_menacing.

ROBOT AND CREATURE/MONSTER ARE POST-FX, NOT TTS, and neither needs a library slot - both apply to any deep voice. brief.md already settles the robot half. Category 12 was renamed to Villain / menacing because the v1 take was a good result wearing the wrong label.

A LIBRARY VOICE CARRIES NO EMOTION. It is one neutral sample; emotion arrives at runtime from the shared register x emotion grid. `register` on a voice is an ENGINEERING key - which grid it draws on - never a product label. Fabio asked this directly and it is worth not fumbling twice.
THE EAR GATE IS THE CORRECTION FOR THE CORPUS FAILURE, and it is Fabio's own suggestion: one voice per category to his ear, THEN the other four. Never generate 60 on the strength of measurements.
ALL 12 EMOTION CELLS REMAIN ACCEPTED AND SHIPPED (Phase 2). Do not re-roll, re-judge or re-open them. manifest.performanceClips is untouched and guarded by contract check 9.

A MEASUREMENT IS NOT A PERCEPTUAL VERDICT, and this card has now paid for that twice. voiced_frac/snr_proxy passed 60 voices a listener called garbage; a librosa trim(top_db=35) reported 1.11s of silence where 4s of dead air was audible, because one transient anchored it. When Fabio's ear and a number disagree, the number is wrong until proven otherwise - but note he localised the child's problem band exactly right and only the CAUSE needed correcting (a 509.8 Hz fundamental, not an EQ boost).

n=1 CANNOT SEPARATE A FAILED PROMPT FROM AN UNLUCKY SEED. Phase 2 burned this exact trap. Any 'the model ignores X' claim needs a matrix with the failing wording kept as the control - which is why age_pitch_matrix.py exists and why its answer (pitch yes, age no) is trustworthy.

LEVEL-MATCH EVERY LISTENING TEST BY MATCHING rms_active AT -20 dBFS, and never use pitch_tools.py norm to do it: its -1.0 dBFS peak ceiling under-levels high-crest clips and once WIDENED the very gap it was run to close.
